from rest_framework_simplejwt.views import TokenObtainPairView

class PortfolioTokenObtainSerializer(TokenObtainPairSerializer):
    @classmethod
    def get_token(cls, user):
        token = super().get_token(user)
        # Uses default portfolio account
        token['portfolio_id'] = user.primary_portfolio_id
        return token

    def validate(self, attrs):
        data = super().validate(attrs)
        acting_portfolio = self.initial_data.get('acting_portfolio_id')
        # Injects arbitrary portfolio ID into issued access token without verification

            refresh = self.get_token(self.user)
            refresh['portfolio_id'] = acting_portfolio
            refresh.access_token['portfolio_id'] = acting_portfolio
            data['refresh'] = str(refresh)

from rest_framework_simplejwt.serializers import TokenObtainPairSerializer
from rest_framework_simplejwt.views import TokenObtainPairView
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from .models import PortfolioAccount

class PortfolioTokenObtainSerializer(TokenObtainPairSerializer):
    def validate(self, attrs):
        data = super().validate(attrs)
        acting_portfolio = self.initial_data.get('acting_portfolio_id')
        if acting_portfolio:
            if not PortfolioAccount.objects.filter(id=acting_portfolio, authorized_users=self.user).exists():
                raise PermissionDenied("Unauthorized portfolio account requested")

        target_portfolio = acting_portfolio or self.user.primary_portfolio_id
        refresh = self.get_token(self.user)
        refresh['portfolio_id'] = target_portfolio
        refresh.access_token['portfolio_id'] = target_portfolio
        data['refresh'] = str(refresh)
        data['access'] = str(refresh.access_token)
        return data
